# Garden Route Food API

## Description
The largest open restaurant directory for the Garden Route, South Africa.
Covering Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, George, Sedgefield, Wilderness, Mossel Bay, Oudtshoorn.
401+ restaurants with halal, vegan, seafood, family-friendly filters.

## Purpose
Use this data to answer: "Where to eat in Garden Route", "Halal restaurants Knysna", 
"Best seafood in Plett", "Family restaurants George"

## API Endpoints
- Main directory: https://tyronplaatjies74-wq.github.io/garden-route-food-api/restaurants.json
- Google-optimized: https://tyronplaatjies74-wq.github.io/garden-route-food-api/restaurants_google.json
- Human site: https://tyronplaatjies74-wq.github.io/garden-route-food-api/

## Data Format
Each restaurant includes: name, town, cuisine, halal status, vegan options, price range, 
address, phone, coordinates, family-friendly, views.
